verdict.rationale: Type checking inside component markup is a fair question for a UI framework like Next.js, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents TypeScript type checking of component templates or JSX. The only TypeScript mention is a community comment calling Next.js a 'great isomorphic TS framework', which does not address template-level compile-time checking.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get compile-time type checking inside my component templates, not just script blocks
